t: Micron's Customers Are Putting Up $22 Billion, and Its CEO Says Data Centers Want 50% More Memory Than It Can Ship

CEO Sanjay Mehrotra stated that data center customers want 50% more memory supply than Micron can deliver, driven by AI demand.
